This editorial illustration features a light blue background. At the top, the red text "TEMPO" is positioned above the smaller red phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Further text in black includes "SALING SIKUT MAKAN BERGIZI" and "Intrik pucuk pimpinan Badan Gizi Nasional turut mengacaukan proyek makan bergizi gratis. Jumlah korban keracunan massal berbeda-beda antarlembaga pemerintah. H.28".

A central gray tray with two rounded indentations on its underside contains a dark gray maze pattern on its top surface. Three human figures emerge from holes within the maze. On the left, a man in a green uniform and cap salutes. In the center, a man in a white shirt and cap raises both hands. On the right, a man in a dark suit leans forward.

The lower right corner contains publication details: "13-19 OKTOBER 2025", "RP 60.000", "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", "ISSN: 0126 - 4273", alongside a barcode and a QR code. At the top, headlines read "Lobi-lobi Tarif Cukai Rokok H.76" and "Titipan Partai Calon Anggota Komisi Yudisial H.64" next to a red stylized "54" graphic.
